open_lines.statement: Each position-taking API function operates on the standard chess position supplied as FEN.
open_lines.open: The requester would settle acceptance or error behavior for malformed or abbreviated FEN and for FEN that encodes inconsistent or impossible positions.

open_lines.statement: `applyMove(fen, move)` throws `IllegalMoveError` for an illegal move expressed in UCI.
open_lines.open: The requester would settle whether to reject or normalize non-UCI representations such as surrounding whitespace or uppercase letters, and how to handle other out-of-domain move arguments.

open_lines.statement: The rules suite checks known legal-move counts from multiple standard test positions.
open_lines.open: The requester would settle any prescribed fixture list or count depths beyond the start-position depth-2 workload. Any reasonable selection of standard positions with known counts can satisfy the coverage requirement.

open_lines.statement: `legalMoves` takes less than 50 ms on a middlegame position.
open_lines.open: The requester would settle any prescribed middlegame FEN, reference machine, Node.js version or measurement protocol for the 50 ms limit.

open_lines.statement: Counting legal move sequences two plies deep from the standard start takes less than 2 seconds.
open_lines.open: The requester would settle any reference machine, Node.js version or measurement protocol for the 2-second limit.

open_lines.statement: A valid `PROVIDER_TOKEN` supplies a saved credential
open_lines.open: Credential precedence and recovery when both the environment and saved data supply credentials, including when an environment value is invalid, are for the requester to settle.

open_lines.statement: The new-bot form creates a named bot
open_lines.open: How to handle missing names or name collisions among a person's bots is for the requester to settle.

open_lines.statement: The `Conversations` navigation lets the person reopen conversations of the open bot
open_lines.open: Conversation button naming and whether reopening the app automatically selects a last-viewed discussion are for the requester to settle.

open_lines.statement: An interrupted reply leaves its submitted turn recoverable
open_lines.open: Whether to resume an interrupted reply or wait for `Retry` is for the requester to settle.

open_lines.statement: `Save instruction` stores a reusable named instruction
open_lines.open: Whether the saved instruction library is shared among one person's bots or kept per bot is for the requester to settle.

open_lines.statement: Saving edits under the existing instruction name updates that entry
open_lines.open: Whether a bot that is already using the instruction picks up edits immediately or on another `Use <name>` is for the requester to settle.

open_lines.statement: `Delete <name>` removes the saved instruction from the library
open_lines.open: What happens to instructions already active on a bot when the saved entry is deleted is for the requester to settle.

open_lines.statement: `Save task` stores a reusable named request
open_lines.open: Whether the saved task library is shared among one person's bots or kept per bot is for the requester to settle.

open_lines.statement: `Proposed changes` previews the exact requested record change before approval
open_lines.open: For creation, whether a not-yet-assigned order ID is reserved for preview or reported as assigned at confirmation is for the requester to settle. An ID explicitly promised in a preview is part of what the person is asked to approve.

open_lines.statement: A proposal leaves working records untouched until explicitly confirmed
open_lines.open: Retention, expiry and coexistence of pending proposals across turns or reloads are for the requester to settle.

open_lines.statement: Confirmation applies the exact change the person approved when it can still be applied
open_lines.open: The handling of stale proposals, including whether the person must ask again or can review a refreshed proposal, is for the requester to settle.

open_lines.statement: Record changes remain subject to the acting person's record permissions
open_lines.open: Which schema-valid fields beyond the documented examples are permitted for editing is for the requester to settle within the records access rules.

open_lines.statement: A steering follow-up appends a step to work running in the originating conversation
open_lines.open: If multiple tasks can run in one conversation, how a follow-up selects one of them is for the requester to settle.

open_lines.statement: Cancellation stops the task's remaining work when it takes effect
open_lines.open: Whether a step already in flight finishes, is interrupted, or has its result discarded is for the requester to settle within what the stand-in permits.

open_lines.statement: Restart recovery distinguishes an interrupted task from work that is executing
open_lines.open: Whether interrupted work resumes automatically on startup or waits for `Retry task` is for the requester to settle.

open_lines.statement: `Since you were away` reports the person's task activity upon return
open_lines.open: What counts as being away and when the app considers an update seen are for the requester to settle.

open_lines.statement: Narrow windows keep conversation reading available
open_lines.open: The minimum supported viewport width and which secondary areas fold away are for the requester to settle.

open_lines.statement: The chat's visual presentation supports comfortable reading
open_lines.open: The visual treatment, including typography and layout details beyond readable, conversation-centered use, is left to the builder by the request.

added_refusals.statement: A move must start at an occupied square.
Lost castling rights cannot be regained.
Malformed FEN input throws an Error.
A FEN without exactly one king of each color throws an Error.
